cli.title: Xiang OS
cli.description: A command-line interface for exploring Chen Xiang's portfolio, projects, writing, and contact details.
cli.welcome: CLI ready. Explore the site without leaving the keyboard.
cli.commandHint: Type 'help' to see commands. Use Tab to complete and ↑/↓ for history.
cli.commands: Commands: help, pwd, ls, cd, cat, echo, mkdir, touch, locale, whoami, about, experience, skills, contact, projects, blog, search, open, history, clear, exit. Separate commands with ';', write files with '>' or '>>', and filter listings with '| grep QUERY'.
cli.emptyBlog: No blog posts are published yet.
cli.unavailable: The live portfolio catalogue is unavailable right now. Profile commands still work.
cli.missingArgument: This command needs an argument. Try 'help COMMAND'.
cli.invalidIndex: No catalogue entry exists at that index.
cli.nothingToGrep: grep can only filter a listing or search result.
cli.openUnavailable: That item does not have a public destination to open.
cli.historyEmpty: No commands have been run in this session.
